profile.headline: Control Systems, Simulation and Software Engineer
profile.summary: Work proficiently with Allen Bradley P.L.C. 5000 series processors revisions 10 through 30, Allen Bradley Panel Views 1200 through 1500e. Worked with Mitsubishi P.L.C. software. Worked with and programmed Fanuc Robotics controller series R30iA, R30iB. Received Fanuc Robotics North America 2D, 3DMV, & 3DL V-iRVision Operation and Programming training. Also received Dispense Tool, HandlingPro, PaintPro (for General Industry, & Automotive), PaintTool, Paint Electrical controller maintenance using R-30iB controllers, Duel Check Safety training, Device Net setup and functionality, and Ethernet IP setup and functionality. Drive Executive, DLR Tool and Connected Components Workbench software packages.

positions.title: Control Systems Software Engineer
positions.description:
Control systems, Simulation and Software engineer. Working with Cognex Vision-Pro Ether-inspect 11 software, for part inspections, Data Man for hand scanners and Cognex In-Sight for vision inspection cameras. Also working with Allen Bradley PLC’s, 1756 series and Rockwell Automation Studio 5000 software versions 32, v33 and v34; as well as Factory Talk Studio version 11.  Siemens Step-7 Simatic Manager PLC logic, v7.54, 7.56 & 7.57, and Siemens Total Integrated Automation Portal versions 13, v15.1, v16 & v17.  Mitsubishi PLC’s using GX Works-2 Logix. Writing and editing C++, C# and Python programming languages script code as needed. Working with both Fanuc Robotics R-30iB+ micro-controllers for CRX-10iA/L Cobots and Universal Behco Cobots. Also worked with Fanuc R-30iB+ standard controllers and ABB IRC5 controllers.
Installed vision inspection and Lot control equipment at both Ford Dearborn Niche Engine plant and Ford Sterling Axle in Sterling Heights Michigan. Installed Conveyance & Robotic work cells at both Ford Rawsonville, Ypsilanti, Mi. and The Ford Van Dyke Electric Powertrain facilities. Programmed battery vison inspection stations for both Ford Rawsonville and Ford Mexico. Programmed Fanuc Robotics equipment, using 3DV, for Stellantis Kokomo, Indian Transmission plant.
Provided support for the Integration as well the site testing. Emergency service support for the WP projects. Performed system installation, safety implementation, and sequence testing to ensure system integration and safety programming are activated and working properly. Assisted service and engineering with the field installation and test of new control systems. Provided production support & support to complete open issues on site. Interfaced with manufacturers and vendors of software and application products, especially about problem diagnosis and resolution. Responded to service calls to troubleshoot, diagnose, and repair programming and system failures.

positions.title: Maintenance Area Supervisor
positions.locationName: Sterling Heights Assembly Plant South paint shop
positions.description:
Contracted to Stellantis / FCA-Chrysler Sterling Height Assembly plant in the South paint shop as a Maintenance Area Supervisor and Professional Maintenance Specialist. The Maintenance Area Supervisor is responsible for assisting and coaching team leaders and team members on daily maintenance operations in support of the production process. Responsibilities include but not limited to:
• Support related automation and controls of manufacturing operations. 
• Plan project operations that establish priorities and sequences for manufacturing product utilizing knowledge of trades, methods, machinery and equipment capabilities and manpower requirements to coordinate activities according to World Class Manufacturing (WCM) standards Coordinate the operations and training of total maintenance system (TMS), OEM (original equipment manufacturer), SMP (standard maintenance procedures) and plant schedules. 
Professional Maintenance Specialist is responsible for maintaining Programmable Logic Controller, (PLC) systems, perform logic changes for the Factory Information System, (FIS), assist on critical breakdowns, perform (WCM) & (TMS) activities.

positions.title: Controls Service Engineer
positions.description:
Contracted to Encore Automation as a Field Service Engineer. Provided P.L.C., and robotics support during the launch of the Chrysler Jeep Sealer cell at Chrysler Toledo North Assembly plant, Ohio. Provided P.L.C. support during robot decommissioning at Chrysler Toledo South Supplier Park Assembly Plant. Also provided Powder recommissioning support at Toledo Supplier Park. Provided P.L.C. support and training during C-zone, (Engine Compartment), Clear Coat Paint, Powder system, and Sealer line upgrades and modifications at Chrysler’s Jefferson North Assembly plant. Provided P.L.C., robotics, and training support during installation and upgrades of Feather Duster systems and Powder systems at Chryslers Warren Truck Assembly plant. Also, registered as the plant powder support engineer for Warren Truck Powder booth operation. Provided P.L.C., robotics, and training support of operation and maintenance of Powder Systems at Chrysler Belvidere Assembly plant. Provided Sealer deck Installation support at Chrysler’s Windsor Assembly facility, Canada.
Provided P.L.C., and electrical engineering support during Powder system upgrades and modifications at GM Lords Town production facility. Provided robotic installation support at GM Lansing Delta facility. 
Provided robotic installation support at Honda CRV facility, Alliston, Canada. Provided P.L.C., & robotic installation and start-up support at Subaru Automobiles Indiana.
Worked proficiently with Allen Bradley P.L.C. 5000 series processors revisions 10 through 20, Allen Bradley Panel Views 1200 through 1500e. Worked with Mitsubishi P.L.C. software. Worked with and programmed Fanuc Robotics controller series R30iA, R30iB. Received Fanuc Robotics North America 2D, 3DMV, & 3DL V-iRVision Operation and Programming training. Also received Dispense Tool, HandlingPro, PaintPro, PaintTool, Paint Electrical controller maintenance using R-30iB controllers, and DCS training.

positions.title: Field Service Engineer
positions.description: Contracted to Gonzalez Automated Production Systems as a P.L.C. programmer; sent to Ford Chicago Heights Stamping plant to provided field service support and installation support. Debugged Allen Bradley Panel View’s: 600, and 1500 H.M.I. communication faults; troubleshot Fanuc robot controller R30-iA collision detection faults, and servo-gun temperature faults on the Ford Escape welding line. Installed and upgraded ladder logic in Controls logic 5000 controllers using RS-logix-5000 version 19.01. Debugged multiple robot faults and camera vision software errors for the installation of the new Ford Lincoln. Also, troubleshot and repaired PC system errors on Phoenix Contact touch screen monitors.

positions.title: Field Service Engineer
positions.description:
Contracted to Cinetic Automation as a Field Service, Installation, and Launch, Robotics/P.L.C. Engineer. Trained at Cinetic to program Allen Bradley P.L.C. 1756 using RS-Logix 5550. Using A.O.I.’s in logic, setup and programmed Panelview 1000’s. and Powerflex 755 VFD modules. Also trained in Semiens 7 software, and Mitsubishi P.L.C.  software packages. Trained to program Fanuc robots, R-2000iB, and M-900iA, using R-30iA, and R-30iB robot controllers.

Provided field service installation and launch support at Caterpillar engine plant in Griffin, Georgia. Also, provided service support at Chrysler transmission plant in Dundee, Michigan. Laid-off due to lack of work.

positions.title: Process Engineer
positions.description:
Install, set-up, and program robotic equipment with integration to die-cast machines and trim press operations. Integrate vision systems for product detection and quality. Integrate safety systems on   
machines that are running automation.
